summary: Specifies a certificate extension for carrying Network Function Types (NFTypes) of the 5G system in X.509 v3 public key certificates, profiled as in RFC 5280. It is a standards-track specification.

eli5.summary: Parts of a 5G network have different jobs. This lets a digital ID card say which job its owner does, so others can tell what role it has.

questions: what is the x.509 nftype extension
how do 5g network functions identify their type in certificates
